summary: xAI launched Build Mode, an early beta feature in Grok that lets subscribers describe an app, game, website or dashboard in natural language and have Grok generate and iteratively refine a working version, publishable via a shareable link.

practices.reason: The feature describes a natural-language-to-code build loop with live preview and iterative editing, but gives no implementation detail an engineering team could replicate.
practices.quote: Describe what you want Grok writes the code and builds a working preview inside the conversation. From there it keeps building with you: change the layout, add a feature, restyle anything.
